svg.title: The outcome of each structured output run
svg.desc: A dot matrix of 600 runs on the Mac with four Qwen3 models on Ollama. Rows are the flat, nested, union, and enum schemas under ToolStrategy and ProviderStrategy, and columns are the 0.6B, 1.7B, 4B, and 8B models. Blue dots are valid on the first call, amber dots are valid after a retry, and rose dots raised. ProviderStrategy raised on every union run at build time and on 3 enum runs on the 4B model, and was valid otherwise. ToolStrategy raised on 19 of 20 nested runs on 0.6B and 10 of 10 on 8B.
svg.text: Each dot is one run on the Mac. Every ProviderStrategy union run raised in create_agent.
